title: Rotate the object clockwise around the 9-anchor
written_solution: Use the cell colored 9 as a rotation center. Rotate every other nonzero cell 90° clockwise around that anchor, preserve its color, and keep the anchor itself unchanged.
program_solution: (rule! (let ((dummy 0)) (let* ((anchor (first (find-color g 9))) (objs (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? (at g (first p) (second p)) (list 0 9)))) (grid-positions g)))) (for/fold ((out (set-cell (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) (first anchor) (second anchor) 9))) ((p (in-list objs))) (let* ((dr (- (first p) (first anchor))) (dc (- (second p) (second anchor))) (r (+ (first anchor) dc)) (c (- (second anchor) dr))) (if (in-bounds? r c (rows g) (cols g)) (set-cell out r c (at g (first p) (second p))) out))))))
